parsed.why: Patterned lethal violence against trans women (multiple 2024-2025 shootings), police/health system failure, religious court striking self-ID, moral panic framing. Law exists but protections unimplemented; societal violence and weak institutions dominate.

State threat-framing (presidential decree, vigilante mobs tied to it), police raids on LGBT venues, a trans traveller's death in custody, local 'rehabilitation' raids, Aceh caning. Escalating official hostility plus documented violence.

Criminalisation enforced episodically (2022, 2024 convictions), but 2023 saw no arrests, no trans-specific violence documented, no targeting of trans people; thin-data, latent statute plus ostracism and no recognition—elevated, not high.

85% believe attacking trans people acceptable; state-imposed custody harm (birth-sex prison placement, forced shaving, HIV denial) under state of exception; gang targeting; police impunity historically—recourse exists but weak.

Direct traveller-facing exposure: airport refusals, X-ray anatomical checks, deportations of trans visitors, criminal presentation offence with convictions, detention abuse, no recourse. Repeated documented pattern across a decade.
